description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Vladimir''' drains blood from the target enemy, dealing magic damage and [[File:Heal power icon.svg|20px|link=Healing|An icon representing the keyword Heal]] [[:Healing|healing]] himself. He then generates 1 point of ''[[File:Fury resource.png|20px|link=Manaless#Fury|An icon representing the keyword Fury]] [[:Manaless#Fury|Crimson Rush]]'' over the [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown.
description.text: Active: Vladimir drains blood from the target enemy, dealing magic damage and healing himself. He then generates 1 point of Crimson Rush over the  cooldown.

description2.raw: At 2 points of ''[[File:Fury resource.png|20px|link=Manaless#Fury|An icon representing the keyword Fury]] [[:Manaless#Fury|Crimson Rush]]'', '''Vladimir''' surges, gaining [[File:Movement speed icon.png|15px|link=Movement speed]] 10% / 20% / 30% / 40% (based on level) '''bonus''' movement speed decaying over 0.5 seconds while the ''[[File:Fury resource.png|20px|link=Manaless#Fury|An icon representing the keyword Fury]] [[:Manaless#Fury|Crimson Rush]]'' depletes over 2.5 seconds. ''[[File:Fury resource.png|20px|link=Manaless#Fury|An icon representing the keyword Fury]] [[:Manaless#Fury|Crimson Rush]]'' depletes 75% slower during ''[[File:Vladimir Sanguine Pool.png|20xpx|border|link=Vladimir#Sanguine Pool|An icon for Vladimir's ability Sanguine Pool]] [[Vladimir#Sanguine Pool|Sanguine Pool]]'', ''[[File:Vladimir Tides of Blood.png|20xpx|border|link=Vladimir#Tides of Blood|An icon for Vladimir's ability Tides of Blood]] [[Vladimir#Tides of Blood|Tides of Blood]]'', or [[File:Stasis icon.png|20px|link=Invulnerability#Stasis|An icon representing the keyword Stasis (buff)]] [[:Invulnerability#Stasis|stasis]].
description2.text: At 2 points of Crimson Rush, Vladimir surges, gaining  10% / 20% / 30% / 40% (based on level) bonus movement speed decaying over 0.5 seconds while the Crimson Rush depletes over 2.5 seconds. Crimson Rush depletes 75% slower during Sanguine Pool, Tides of Blood, or stasis.

description3.raw: Casting ''Transfusion'' during the surge consumes all ''[[File:Fury resource.png|20px|link=Manaless#Fury|An icon representing the keyword Fury]] [[:Manaless#Fury|Crimson Rush]]'' to deal [[File:Successfully enhanced damage magic icon.png|20px|link=Damage#Successful_ability_casts]] 85% increased damage and [[File:Heal power icon.svg|20px|link=Healing|An icon representing the keyword Heal]] [[:Healing|heal]] '''Vladimir''' for an additional 30 – 220 (based on level)[[Category:Debug]] (+ 5% (+ 4% per 100 AP) of his '''missing''' health). The additional healing is reduced to「 35% 」「 10.5 – 77 (based on level)[[Category:Debug]] (+ 1.75% (+ 1.4% per 100 AP) of his '''missing''' health) 」against [[File:Minion icon.png|20px|link=Minion|An icon representing the keyword Minion]] [[:Minion|minions]].
description3.text: Casting Transfusion during the surge consumes all Crimson Rush to deal 85% increased damage and heal Vladimir for an additional 30 – 220 (based on level)Category:Debug (+ 5% (+ 4% per 100 AP) of his missing health). The additional healing is reduced to「 35% 」「 10.5 – 77 (based on level)Category:Debug (+ 1.75% (+ 1.4% per 100 AP) of his missing health) 」against minions.

leveling.raw:
'''Magic Damage:'''
80 / 100 / 120 / 140 / 160 (+ 60% AP)
'''Heal:'''
20 / 25 / 30 / 35 / 40 (+ 35% AP)

leveling3.raw:
'''Increased Damage:'''
148 / 185 / 222 / 259 / 296 (+ 111% AP)

notes.raw: * Even though the healing effect is visualized as a projectile, the healing itself triggers as soon as the cast time completes. * ''Vladimir's'' resource bar indicates his current ''[[File:Fury resource.png|20px|link=Manaless#Fury|An icon representing the keyword Fury]] [[:Manaless#Fury|Crimson Rush]]'' and changes colors depending on the charge-up stage of his surge. *# White while generating the first stack and while at 1 stack (there is no time-out period). *# Orange while generating the second stack. *# Red while he is surging (''Crimson Rush'' will deplete over 2.5 seconds once triggered). ** Each stack generates over-time (''Transfusion's'' cooldown). * '''Vladimir''' can cast [[File:Vladimir Sanguine Pool.png|20xpx|border|link=Vladimir#Sanguine Pool|An icon for Vladimir's ability Sanguine Pool]] [[Vladimir#Sanguine Pool|Sanguine Pool]] and [[File:Vladimir Hemoplague.png|20xpx|border|link=Vladimir#Hemoplague|An icon for Vladimir's ability Hemoplague]] [[Vladimir#Hemoplague|Hemoplague]] during ''Transfusion's'' cast time. * The [[File:Fury resource.png|20px|link=Manaless#Fury|An icon representing the keyword Fury]] [[:Manaless#Fury|Crimson Rush]] depletes normally while under [[File:Revival icon.png|20px|link=Death#Ways to prevent death when reaching zero health|An icon representing the keyword Resurrection]] [[:Death#Ways to prevent death when reaching zero health|resurrection]] effects. * ''Transfusion's'' cast is special cased to not be cancelled if the target becomes [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]], [[File:Death icon.svg|20px|link=Death|An icon representing the keyword Death]] [[:Death|dies]], or is too far away or no longer in [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] during the cast time. ** If the target is untargetable by the time the cast completes, however, ''Tranfusion'' will not deal them damage but still grant '''Vladimir''' the healing.
notes.text:
Even though the healing effect is visualized as a projectile, the healing itself triggers as soon as the cast time completes.
Vladimir's resource bar indicates his current Crimson Rush and changes colors depending on the charge-up stage of his surge.
# White while generating the first stack and while at 1 stack (there is no time-out period).
# Orange while generating the second stack.
# Red while he is surging (Crimson Rush will deplete over 2.5 seconds once triggered).
* Each stack generates over-time (Transfusion's cooldown).
Vladimir can cast Sanguine Pool and Hemoplague during Transfusion's cast time.
The Crimson Rush depletes normally while under resurrection effects.
Transfusion's cast is special cased to not be cancelled if the target becomes untargetable, dies, or is too far away or no longer in sight during the cast time.
* If the target is untargetable by the time the cast completes, however, Tranfusion will not deal them damage but still grant Vladimir the healing.
